shapeSummary: Chain outer link with two vertical side plates (10x8x1 mm) at z=±2.5 joined by two 3 mm pins at x=±4 along Z, plus two flat 1 mm thick tabs at the bottom extending outward in ±X. Each tab has one 4.2 mm vertical through-hole, with holes 16 mm apart. Overall size is about 22x8x6 mm.
warnings: Only the 16 mm hole spacing and 8 mm pitch are stated; all other dimensions are estimated from the photo.
Hole diameter of 4.2 mm is assumed from an M4 screw.
The analysis lists hole axis z, but the photo shows the tabs lying flat with vertical holes. I used a Y-axis hole with Y up, so the holes pass through the tabs.
Plate outline is simplified to rectangles; rounded plate ends, tab bend radii and pin heads are omitted.
Pin diameter and plate spacing are guesses.

tab_t = 1.0
plates = None
for z in (-2.5, 2.5):
    p = cq.Workplane('XY').box(10, 8, 1).translate((0, 4, z))
    plates = p if plates is None else plates.union(p)
pins = (cq.Workplane('XY').cylinder(6, 1.5, direct=(0, 0, 1)).translate((-4, 4, 0))
        .union(cq.Workplane('XY').cylinder(6, 1.5, direct=(0, 0, 1)).translate((4, 4, 0))))
tabs = None
for x in (-7.5, 7.5):
    t = cq.Workplane('XY').box(7, tab_t, 6).translate((x, tab_t / 2, 0))
    tabs = t if tabs is None else tabs.union(t)
part = plates.union(pins).union(tabs)
holes = (cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(-8, 0), (8, 0)]).circle(2.1).extrude(-5))
part = part.cut(holes)
